0022600026.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-6, 2-3 at home, on a five-game losing streak) sit 9th in the East and 2 games back in the Southeast, while the Boston Celtics (6-2, 5-0 at home, on a one-game winning streak) are 3rd in the East and 1.5 games back in the Atlantic. Charlotte is missing Grant Williams (out, hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (out, hamstring strain), and Dennis Schroder (thigh) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness) and has Payton Pritchard (eye abrasion) listed as day-to-day with a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in the 2025-26 season the Hornets lost the series 1-2, including a 113-102 loss in Boston on April 7, 2026.
